dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Hello there, my friendly and passionate friend. I'm Vert Jr., and I hail from Quartier Lyonnais in the Court of Fontaine, where I'm really known as Petit Vert.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: After arriving in Yilong Wharf, my friends in Liyue nicknamed me Vert Jr. based on my name's meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Vert, or green, is the color of tea leaves. So far, it's made the locals more affable toward me and helped build my personal brand...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: And in the long term, I'll be having an extended stay in Yilong Wharf to carefully study and promote the local cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Hmm... Why don't I call my first travel guide "Vert's Vouchsafes"!
